how-25-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the specimen, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-25-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the specimen, then tap three things you notice.

how-25-02-compare.page: Put the boots under one tray and the water under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-25-02-compare.say: Put the boots under one tray and the water under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-25-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.
how-25-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.

how-25-02-det.page: Pick 3 threats, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name the threat. Predict a solution that fits, and watch it at work.
how-25-02-det.say: Pick three threats, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name the threat. Predict a solution that fits, and watch it at work.

how-25-02-partc.page: Draw your solution in action in the park. Label the threat it stops, and one thing you will count or measure to check it.
how-25-02-partc.say: Draw your solution in action in the park. Label the threat it stops, and one thing you will count or measure to check it.
